What Affects the Cost of Home Interiors?

Nine factors that decide your interior budget, and how to plan it without surprises.

Home / Guides / What Affects the Cost of Home Interiors?

By the Manzil Homes design team · Visakhapatnam

Every home is different, so a fair interior budget can only be worked out after understanding your space and choices. What we can explain is what drives the cost, so you can plan wisely.

1. Scope of work

Full-home interiors, a few rooms, or only a modular kitchen and wardrobes? Scope is the biggest factor.

2. Size and layout

Larger homes need more material and labour, but layout matters too. Rooms with many corners, niches or high ceilings need more custom work.

3. Board and material grades

Plywood and board grades, especially moisture-resistant and marine-grade options suited to coastal Vizag, vary a lot in price and lifespan.

4. Finishes

Laminates, acrylic, lacquered glass, veneers and PU finishes each have different costs and looks.

5. Hardware

Soft-close hinges, drawer channels, organisers and handles from premium brands cost more but make daily use smoother for years.

6. False ceilings and lighting

Simple ceilings with a few lights cost far less than layered designs with coves, profile lights and decorative fixtures.

7. Civil and services work

Breaking walls, re-tiling, rewiring or re-plumbing adds cost, which is common in renovations.

8. Furniture and décor

Custom furniture, loose furniture, curtains and décor can be included or added later.

9. Timeline

Very tight deadlines may need extra teams or working hours.

How to plan your budget

  • Decide your must-haves and nice-to-haves
  • Spend on what you touch daily: kitchen, wardrobes and hardware
  • Choose materials suited to the climate, so they last
  • Ask for an itemised BOQ so you can adjust line by line
  • Keep a small contingency for changes

Frequently Asked Questions

Why don't designers give a price immediately?

Because cost depends on scope, size, materials and finishes. A fair estimate needs a site visit or floor plan and a discussion of your choices.

How can I reduce interior costs?

Prioritise rooms, choose durable mid-range finishes where they are seen less, and avoid late design changes.

Do you share an itemised quote?

Yes. We provide a detailed BOQ with materials and specifications, and track every variation.
